recognize_zh: 肋膜液抹片中成群的大型細胞，核偏心、染色質呈粗塊狀、細胞質豐富且深藍、部分可見核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof），是非典型漿細胞；出現在體液中代表骨髓瘤髓外侵犯。
features: Numerous large atypical plasma cells, many 2-3 times the size of adjacent red cells
Eccentric round nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin and occasional small visible nucleoli
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof in some cells
Irregular, frayed cytoplasmic borders with small blebs
Background of red cells without significant reactive mesothelial or inflammatory cells in this field
describe_en: Pleural fluid cytospin shows numerous large atypical plasma cells. The cells have eccentrically placed round nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin, occasional small nucleoli, and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, several with a perinuclear hof and irregular cytoplasmic borders. Reactive mesothelial cells and inflammatory cells are not prominent in this field. Findings are consistent with pleural involvement by plasma cell myeloma (myelomatous pleural effusion); confirmation by flow cytometry or CD138 and light chain studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells have central nuclei, a two-toned cytoplasm with peripheral skirt/windows, and cluster together, rather than eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof.
Reactive plasma cells are fewer, smaller, and mature with polytypic light chains, whereas these are numerous, large, and atypical.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or large B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytoid features
ddx.vs: These show more blastic chromatin, prominent central nucleoli, and high proliferation, and require clinical and immunophenotypic correlation (CD20, EBER, MYC) to separate.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive three-dimensional clusters with nuclear molding and are keratin positive, CD138/light chain restricted plasma cells are not.
